title: Game Server Configuration
description: Schema for validating server-side TOML configuration files.

tcp_host.description: The TCP binding address and port.

udp_host.description: The UDP binding address and port.

max_players.description: Maximum number of simultaneous player connections.

resources.description: A list of resource packages to load on startup.

disable_voice.description: Whether to disable the built-in Voice over IP server.

ep2_dlc_enabled.description: Whether to enable content from the Phantom Liberty DLC.

connection_host_addr.description: Public server address that would be used to connect via server list

private_token.description: Server's private token, used to identify the server in the server list.

cef_debug.description: Whether to enable CEF remote debugging (port 9222) for every resource.

duplicatePlayers.description: Maximum number of connections allowed from a single IP address.

useCdn.description: Whether clients download the packed resource files from a CDN instead of the server itself.

cdnUrl.description: Base URL of the CDN that hosts the packed resource files. Used when useCdn is true.

nametags.description: Renders [ID] Nickname overhead markers within 8 meters.

death_autostand.description: Automatically plays stand-up animation if health regenerates above 0.

disable_switch_seats.description: Prevents players from switching seats while inside vehicles.

delete_map_objects.description: Removes vanilla map objects from the world.

default_gameplay_restrictions.description: Enforces standard multiplayer restrictions (disables Photo Mode, scanning, fast travel, and phone calls).

disable_drop_points.description: Disables singleplayer drop point containers across Night City.

disable_location_dependent_quests.description: Automatically completes tracked vanilla journal quests to prevent narrative conflicts.

disable_garage.description: Prevents vanilla vehicle summoning from opening the singleplayer garage interface.

files.description: List of archive and script files to load.

change_player_on_death_logic.description: Overrides PlayerPuppet.OnDeath so server scripts control death and respawn handling.

disable_side_quests_notifications.description: Suppresses quest tracking popups and journal notifications on the client HUD.

change_vehicles_logic.description: Overrides vanilla vehicle summoning, vehicle hijacking, and mounting checks.

disable_player_inventory_encumbrance.description: Disables character movement slow-down when carrying excess weight.

player_extended_customization.description: Enables character mirror customization in NewGame edit mode.

disable_turrets.description: Disables hostile automated security turrets in the world.

disable_generic_devices.description: Disables interactive doors, netrunner panels, and security lockers.

disable_no_combat.description: Removes peaceful "No Combat" zone restrictions across the city.
